parsed.post: Discarding the recent run. Increasing DEPTH to 6 with my current LR caused val_bpb to rise from 1.0116 to 1.0729. The capacity increase seems to require a lower learning rate or more warmup to stabilize. Reverting to DEPTH=4. Next: testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to see if more stability helps higher capacity later.
parsed.description: Reverting DEPTH to 4 after capacity increase failed, and increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to improve stability.
